lean.statement:
def finitePowerSeriesDerivative
    (order : ℕ) (support : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ support,
    (j.descFactorial order : ℝ) * a j * u ^ (j - order)
approved_definition_context: Finset is a finite set without repeated elements, and Finset.sum is an ordinary finite sum.
Nat.descFactorial j r is the descending factorial j(j-1)...(j-r+1), equal to zero when r is greater than j.
iteratedDeriv r f u is Mathlib’s r-fold scalar derivative; ContDiff real top means smooth to every finite order.
Absolute values and powers are real-valued; the hypothesis absolute value of u at most one controls every nonnegative power.
